Name: Secret Candy
Author: undare
Description:
[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]About 
[/size][/color]
[size=3]Uncover what happened with the candy shop in the woods, accesible by going near the Cherry blossom tree on the lower left corner of the Secret woods.[/size]

[size=3]Be warned! that place is not alone![/size]
[size=3]Is recomended to have something to defend yourself and maybe something to light your way.[/size]

[size=3]You can find notes scattered through the new area, maybe they can bring some insight on what happened to the new team in charge of the workshop.[/size]

[size=3]Discover the trade secrets of the new machines they were making and uncover what lies below the workshop. [/size]
[size=3]Maybe you can get your hands on some abandoned supplies and something more!.[/size]


[size=5]
[color=#a4c2f4]Balance
[/color][/size]
[size=3]I took my sweet time to make math to integrate the new Candymaking mechanic into the SDV economy.[/size]
[size=3]It won´t overshadow the "meta" money-making farming strategies, but they will provide a competitive income for those willing to put effort on it.[/size]

[size=3]The main machine called "Secret Bunny Mold" can produce 1 to 6 Bunny shaped units at randon[/size]
[size=3]and[/size]
[size=3]Above that, those resulting candies can be of : normal, silver, gold or Iridium quiality.[/size]

[size=3]So, the worst outcome would be just getting 1 normal candy, while the godlike outcome would be getting 6 iridium quality candies![/size]
[size=3]The balance i did will make the farmer profit with a chance of 85% of the time.[/size]
[size=3]When the farmer don't profit from it, he/she will benefit from the edible buffs from the food.[/size]
[size=3]Also[/size]
[size=3]Being an Artisan good make them good gifts too![/size]




[color=#f9cb9c][size=5]Artwork and Prupose[/size][/color]

[size=3]The new machines change animation based on the ingredient you put into them, it took a while to pull that one but is worth it! [color=#d5a6bd]<3[/color][/size]

[size=3]The mod was fully inspired and made for the SDV discord spring mod contest.[/size]
[size=3]Themes you can find on the mod are : [color=#d5a6bd]Cherry Blossom[/color], [color=#f4cccc]Bunnies[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Allergies [/color]and [color=#f9cb9c]Picnic[/color][/size]
[/b]
